title: Frontline Request Compressor and Technical Fit Assessment
creator: Priya Desai
description: Problem: Sales and CS submit a high volume of enterprise feature asks with inconsistent signal (missing impact, regulatory constraints, or frequency). Engineering spends cycles clarifying scope, delaying prioritization and inflating perceived effort. Goal: reduce friction at first contact with a light-weight compressor that consolidates duplicates, scores asks on objective criteria, and produces a 1-page 'technical fit' that is sufficient for a first-pass prioritization decision.
background: Recent Q4 intake review showed ~34% of inbound enterprise requests lacked minimum implementation details (auth/data residency/expected throughput). Several Eng teams reported >48h clarification loops before a scoping meeting. Current ad-hoc CS notes live in tickets, spreadsheets, and Slack which blocks rapid bundling and economic prioritization.
proposed_solution: 1) Intake: Introduce a short, required 'Frontline Compressor' form embedded in CS intake flow (Zendesk -> Airtable) that captures: problem statement, customer segment, frequency/scale, security/regulatory flags, desired UX, critical success metric, and related accounts. 2) Scoring: Apply an automated scoring matrix (impact, frequency, regulatory complexity, engineering lift, strategic account weight) to produce a priority band (Low/Medium/High). 3) Fit doc: Auto-generate a 1-page 'Technical Fit' that contains score, likely architecture approaches (back-of-envelope), initial risk flags, and recommended next step (bundle/quick-scope/R&D spike). 4) Workflow: Route High and Medium-High to a weekly PM rotation for rapid scoping; Low to a monthly bundler queue. 5) Instrumentation: Add analytics (time-to-triage, percent missing fields, bundling rate) to Console intake dashboard.
scoring_matrix: Fields and weights: Impact (30%), Frequency (20%), Strategic Account (20%), Regulatory/Risk (15% penalty if present), Engineering Lift (15% negative weight). Scoring bands: 70+ = High, 45-69 = Medium, <45 = Low. Example: customer A (new SSO & audit logging) => Impact 28 + Frequency 10 + Strategic 20 - Risk 10 - Lift 6 = 42 (Medium).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Compressor form is required on 80% of new enterprise asks submitted by CS/Sales. 2) Average initial clarification interactions with Eng reduced from 2.1 to <=0.5 per request. 3) Time-to-first-priority-band assigned <=24h for High asks. 4) At least 60% of inbound requests are automatically assigned a bundle candidate or recommended next step. 5) Dashboard shows clear signal of missing-field rate and triage latency.
deliverables:
- Frontline Compressor form (Zendesk template + Airtable mapping)
- Scoring engine (Airtable formulas or small Lambda)
- Technical Fit template generator (Docx/Drive template + auto-fill script)
- PM rotation playbook and bundler queue runbook
- Console dashboard tiles for intake metrics
implementation_steps: 1) Run 1-week discovery with CS + Solutions Eng to finalize required fields (owner: Mateo, due 2026-03-05). 2) Prototype form in Airtable and wiring to Zendesk (owner: Solutions Eng team). 3) Build scoring formulas and test on 120 historical requests to validate thresholds. 4) Create template generator (Drive + small Cloud Function). 5) Pilot for 3 weeks with two CS pods and collect metrics. 6) Iterate and roll to all CS + Sales. 7) Add dashboard cards in Console for visibility.
stakeholders: Product: Priya Desai; CS Lead: Jordan Kim; Sales Ops: Anika Patel; Solutions Eng: Omar Ruiz; Security Reviewer: Linh Nguyen; Eng Liaison: Clara Wells
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: CS adoption friction -> Mitigation: keep form <7 fields and integrate into existing workflow; provide CS template and short training. Risk: scoring over-simplifies nuance -> Mitigation: include free-text rationale and quarterly calibration sessions. Risk: false negatives on regulatory flags -> Mitigation: add mandatory checkboxes and escalation to Security reviewer.
notes: 2026-03-02 sync: CS asked for an 'escape hatch' free text field for early sales conversations; agreed to include but mark as low-confidence. 2026-03-04 PM review: prioritize fields for automation first (impact, account weight, regulatory checkbox). 2026-03-08 pilot plan approved by Solutions Eng; kickoff scheduled 2026-03-11.
